blocks.source: ｸﾘｱ日
blocks.translation: Completion Date

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Substance / Story

blocks.source: グレイセス以来久々にやったテイルズ。ＰＳ３との同時発売だけど、ＰＳ４版でプレイ。
blocks.translation: The first Tales game I've played in a while, since Graces. It was released simultaneously on PS3, but I played the PS4 version.

blocks.source: 前作に当たるゼスティリアは未プレイ。ベルセリアのほうが過去の物語なので、さして問題はない――と思う。少なくとも、知らない話がたくさん出てきて嫌になるということはなかった。
blocks.translation: I hadn't played Zestiria, the preceding game. Since Berseria's story takes place in the past, I don't think that was much of a problem. At least, I never found myself annoyed by a lot of unfamiliar stories coming up.

blocks.source: クリアまでそれなりにサブイベントをこなして５０時間ぐらい。
blocks.translation: It took about 50 hours to clear, including a reasonable number of side quests.

blocks.source: シリーズ初の女性単独主人公。
blocks.translation: The first solo female protagonist in the series.

blocks.source: 勧善懲悪ではなく、主人公が復讐に取り憑かれた悪寄りという異質な物語。結果的に町を壊滅に追い込んだりと、やりたい放題。これはこれで新鮮さがあっていいかも。
blocks.translation: Rather than a story of good versus evil, this is an unusual tale with an evil-leaning protagonist consumed by revenge. She wreaks havoc as she pleases, even ultimately driving towns to ruin. That freshness is nice in its own way.

blocks.source: ただし、後半はけっこう痛々しい展開が多くてちょっと辛かった。ヴェスペリアみたいな冷静な主人公かと思いきや、どんどんヒステリックになっていくので……。終盤はなんとか持ち直してよかった。
blocks.translation: However, the second half had so many rather painful developments that it was a little hard to get through. I thought she would be a calm protagonist like Yuri from Vesperia, but she becomes increasingly hysterical... I'm glad she somehow pulled herself together toward the end.

blocks.source: とはいえ、基本的にはいつものテイルズオブ。ラスボスとの対立軸といい、エンディングの展開といい、過去のシリーズ作品とどこか似通っている。
blocks.translation: That said, at its core, it's a typical Tales of game. From its conflict with the final boss to the events of its ending, it bears some resemblance to past games in the series.

blocks.source: 全体的にストーリーテンポはゆったり。
blocks.translation: Overall, the story's pacing is leisurely.

blocks.source: １つ１つのダンジョンがやや長め。通り過ぎるだけのマップも多め。おつかい的なイベントも意外と多い。
blocks.translation: Each dungeon is somewhat lengthy. There are also quite a few maps that you simply pass through. Fetch-quest-style events are surprisingly common as well.

blocks.source: そのせいか、それなりに劇的なストーリーのはずなのに、中だるみを感じてしまった。
blocks.translation: Perhaps because of that, I felt the story dragged in the middle, even though it was supposed to be fairly dramatic.

blocks.source: フィールドに相当するものはなく、基本的には地図上から行き先を選択するのみ。（街道などの屋外マップがいくらか存在する。）
blocks.translation: There is no equivalent of a field; basically, you simply select your destination from the map. (There are some outdoor maps, such as roads.)

blocks.source: 空の乗り物もなし。行き先はストーリー中のほとんどの時点で制限される。多少の寄り道はあるものの基本的には一本道＋αといったところ。
blocks.translation: There are no aerial vehicles, either. Your destinations are restricted for most of the story. There are some opportunities to take detours, but for the most part it's a linear path with a little extra.

blocks.source: 戦闘勝利時のボイスが少なめ。序盤から「もうそのセリフは聞き飽きたよ」のオンパレード。過去のシリーズ作品だと、ストーリー進行に応じて変化があったりと凝っていたはず。
blocks.translation: There are relatively few voice lines for battle victories. From the early game onward, it's an endless stream of “I'm tired of hearing that line already.” In past games in the series, they seemed to put more effort into this, with the lines changing as the story progressed.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Convenience

blocks.source: 戦闘システム
blocks.translation: Battle System

blocks.source: 通常攻撃は存在せず、ボタン一つで技が発動できる。グレイセフｆではボタン二つだったが、今回はボタン４つに対して術技を割り当てていく。
blocks.translation: There are no normal attacks; you can activate an arte with a single button. Graces f used two buttons, but this time you assign artes to four buttons.

blocks.source: 簡単に術技が発動できるので、シリーズ初心者にも易しい。
blocks.translation: Since artes are easy to activate, the game is accessible even to newcomers to the series.

blocks.source: 反面、ボタン連打でわりとどうにかなってしまうところも。
blocks.translation: On the other hand, mashing buttons can get you through fairly well.

blocks.source: 主人公のベルベットは強いのだけど、ゴリ押し向きなので単調になりがち。色々とキャラを変えてみるとよいかも。
blocks.translation: The protagonist Velvet is strong, but she's suited to brute force, so combat can become monotonous. It might be worth switching between the various characters.

blocks.source: 難易度はほどよいところだが、時々手強いボスがいて苦戦することも。とはいえ、アイテムを使いながら粘っていれば、どうにでもなる程度かと思う。
blocks.translation: The difficulty is generally well balanced, but occasionally you'll encounter a tough boss and struggle. That said, I think you can get through anything if you persist while using items.

blocks.source: 強化システム
blocks.translation: Enhancement System

blocks.source: ヴェスペリアとほぼ同様のスキル習得システム。装備を身につけて戦闘を行い、ポイントが溜まると付属したスキルが入手できる。
blocks.translation: A skill-acquisition system almost identical to Vesperia's. Equip gear and fight battles; once you accumulate enough points, you can acquire the skills attached to it.

blocks.source: ６人６部位で合計３６の装備を管理する必要がある。装備の頻繁な入れ替えが必要となるので、やっぱり結構面倒くさい。
blocks.translation: You need to manage a total of 36 pieces of equipment, with six characters and six equipment slots each. Since equipment needs to be swapped frequently, it becomes fairly tedious.

blocks.source: 今作にはグレイセスｆと同様に、素材を使用した装備強化システムが存在する。……が、上述のスキル習得システムと噛み合っていない。
blocks.translation: Like in Graces f, this game has an equipment enhancement system that uses materials. However, it doesn't mesh with the skill-acquisition system mentioned above.

blocks.source: 多くのスキルを習得するには、装備をコロコロ変える必要がある。……ということは、強化した装備もすぐにお役御免になってしまう可能性が高い。
blocks.translation: To learn many skills, you need to keep changing your equipment. That means enhanced equipment is also highly likely to become obsolete almost immediately.

blocks.source: グレイセスｆでは称号にスキルが紐付いていたので、この問題が発生することはなかった。ここはもうちょっと考慮があればよかった。
blocks.translation: In Graces f, skills were tied to titles, so this problem never arose. This could have used a little more consideration.

blocks.source: 敵を倒せばどんどん良いアイテムを落とす。どんどん術技を覚える。どんどんスキルを習得する。
blocks.translation: Defeat enemies and they keep dropping better items. Keep learning artes. Keep acquiring skills.

blocks.source: 宝箱を開ければどんどん良いアイテムが手に入る。
blocks.translation: Open treasure chests and you'll keep finding better items.

blocks.source: 店に入れば良いアイテムが売っている。お金はほとんど不足しない。
blocks.translation: Enter a shop and you'll find good items for sale. You almost never run short of money.

blocks.source: 至れり尽くせりなんだけど、返ってメリハリに乏しい。見た目が派手なわりに、意外と考えることがない――というのは、このシリーズではよくあること。もうちょっと、プレイヤーの飢餓感を煽ってもいいと思うのだけど。
blocks.translation: It gives you everything you could ask for, but as a result, it lacks much in the way of peaks and valleys. Despite its flashy appearance, there surprisingly isn't much to think about—something that's common in this series. I feel it could do a little more to whet the player's appetite.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Convenience

blocks.source: 道端に細かくアイテムが落ちている。宝箱以外は大した物があるわけではないのだが、個人的にはちょっと面倒だなと思った。
blocks.translation: Small items are scattered along the roads. Other than treasure chests, they aren't anything special, but personally, I found them a little tedious.

blocks.source: 今作の収拾要素である『ねこスピ』＆『ねこにんボックス 』は、手間がかかるわりに報酬が乏しい。景品は衣装などの装飾品がほとんど。しかも色物系ばかり……。
blocks.translation: The collection elements in this game, “Cat Spirits” and “Normin Boxes,” offer meager rewards for the effort required. The prizes are mostly decorative items such as costumes. And they're almost all novelty items...

blocks.source: 致命的なものはないけれど、こういった面倒な要素がところどころに存在する。内容的にはプレイ時間を２／３に縮めたほうがちょうどよいぐらいかも。
blocks.translation: There are no fatal flaws, but these kinds of tedious elements appear here and there. In terms of content, it might have been just right if the playtime had been shortened to two-thirds.

blocks.source: 序盤の移動速度は遅め。アイテムの入手に従ってある程度は高速化する。高速移動できる乗り物（レアボード）も存在するが、登場が中盤以降となる。
blocks.translation: Movement speed is rather slow early on. It increases somewhat as you obtain items. There is also a vehicle that allows high-speed travel (the Rareboard), but it appears only in the middle of the game or later.

blocks.source: サブイベントの発生場所をマップで示してくれるので親切。サブイベントを探して、町中を動き回る必要はなくなった。
blocks.translation: It's helpful that the map shows where side quests begin. You no longer need to run around town looking for them.

blocks.source: このシリーズにしては、取り逃し要素も控えめ。サブイベントのマップ表示と合わせて、攻略情報を見なくともプレイしやすいのはありがたい。
blocks.translation: For this series, there are relatively few missable elements as well. Together with the map display for side quests, it's nice that the game is easy to play without consulting a walkthrough.

blocks.source: ロード時間などの問題は皆無。恐らくＰＳ３版でも大差ないと思う。
blocks.translation: There are no issues with loading times or anything else. I expect the PS3 version is probably not much different.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Visuals

blocks.source: ＰＳ３との同時発売だけあって、ＰＳ４だからといってグラフィックが物凄く強化されているわけではない。ヴェスペリアやグレイセスＦと大差なし。
blocks.translation: Since it was released simultaneously with the PS3 version, the graphics aren't massively enhanced just because this is the PS4 version. There's not much difference from Vesperia or Graces f.

blocks.source: にぎやかな戦闘とかが魅力のシリーズなので、そういうところが堪能できればそれでいいんでないでしょうか。
blocks.translation: Since lively battles and the like are one of the series' appeals, I suppose it's enough if you can enjoy those aspects.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: イベントシーンでメインテーマ的に使われる曲が良好。※ＰＳ４でゲーム起動選択時に流れている曲のこと。
blocks.translation: The song used like a main theme during event scenes is good.※ This is the song that plays when selecting to launch the game on PS4.

blocks.source: しかしながら、全体的にはかなり印象が薄かった。というのも、初期状態ではかなりＢＧＭの音量が抑えられて、ボイスばかりが目立つようになっている。特に戦闘曲は、完全にボイスに負けてしまっていた。
blocks.translation: However, overall, the music left a rather weak impression. The reason is that, in the default settings, the BGM volume is kept quite low, making only the voices stand out. The battle music in particular was completely drowned out by the voices.

blocks.source: 一応、ＢＧＭやボイスなどを各５段階で設定できる。が、色々と音量設定を変えてみても、バランスの悪さは拭い切れなかった。
blocks.translation: You can set the BGM, voices, and so on to one of five levels each. However, no matter how much I changed the various volume settings, I couldn't completely eliminate the poor balance.

blocks.source: ボイスを３段階目にしたところ、イベントシーンでは静かすぎ。戦闘シーンではうるさすぎだと感じた。
blocks.translation: When I set the voices to the third level, I felt they were too quiet during event scenes and too loud during battle scenes.

blocks.source: しっかり聞いてみれば、曲自体は悪くない……かも。
blocks.translation: If you listen closely, the songs themselves might not be bad…… maybe.

blocks.source: 総評
blocks.translation: Overall Assessment

blocks.source: 間違いなく良作なのだけど、あくまで良作止まりという印象。ストーリー的にもゲーム的にも、ヴェスペリアやジアビス程のインパクトは残らなかった。
blocks.translation: It's undoubtedly a good game, but my impression was that it only just qualifies as one. Neither the story nor the gameplay left as much of an impact as Vesperia or the Abyss.

blocks.source: 自分でも不思議なくらい印象に残らなかったのはなんでだろう。過去シリーズとの差別化が乏しいせいですかね。
blocks.translation: I wonder why it left so little of an impression on me—it's almost strange. Maybe it's because it doesn't do enough to distinguish itself from the earlier games in the series.

texts.しっかり聞いてみれば、曲自体は悪くない……かも。: If you listen closely, the songs themselves might not be bad…… maybe.
texts.間違いなく良作なのだけど、あくまで良作止まりという印象。ストーリー的にもゲーム的: It's undoubtedly a good game, but my impression was that it only just qualifies as one. Neither the story nor the gameplay left as much of an impact as Vesperia or the Abyss.
texts.自分でも不思議なくらい印象に残らなかったのはなんでだろう。過去シリーズとの差別化: I wonder why it left so little of an impression on me—it's almost strange. Maybe it's because it doesn't do enough to distinguish itself from the earlier games in the series.
